All six elements build each jann and fill them with a constant desire to travel, typically jaunting about [the Universe](/Planes.aspx?ID=26). The eldest among geniekind, they command respect from their distant offspring. Any jann can grant wishes, not just shuyookhs—a vestige of their ancient power. **[Recall Knowledge - Elemental](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 19 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 17 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14 [Jann](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3002) **Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 156 **Perception** +11; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59) **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Muan](/Languages.aspx?ID=108), [Petran](/Languages.aspx?ID=109), [Pyric](/Languages.aspx?ID=110), [Sussuran](/Languages.aspx?ID=111), [Talican](/Languages.aspx?ID=112), [Thalassic](/Languages.aspx?ID=113); [_truespeech_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1728) **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +8, [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) +10, [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) +8, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +7, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +11 **Str** +4 **Dex** +2 **Con** +2 **Int** +3 **Wis** +3 **Cha** +1 **Items** [Composite Shortbow](/Weapons.aspx?ID=75) (20 arrows), [Scimitar](/Weapons.aspx?ID=38) --- **AC** 20 **Fort** +10 **Ref** +10 **Will** +13 **HP** 60 **Resistances** elemental resistance 5 **Commanding Presence** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=598), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) 20 feet. A creature that enters the aura must succeed at a DC 19 Will save or be [frightened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) (frightened 2 on a critical failure) and is then temporarily immune for 1 minute. A [genie](/Traits.aspx?ID=752) (with the exception of another jann) takes a –4 circumstance penalty to its save.
**Elemental Resistance** The jann's elemental resistance applies to cold, electricity, and fire damage, as well as all damage from elemental sources (including environmental damage from the elemental planes and damage from anything with the [air](/Traits.aspx?ID=527), [earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=585), [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604), [metal](/Traits.aspx?ID=505), [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=732), or [wood](/Traits.aspx?ID=508) trait). --- **Speed** 25 feet, fly 15 feet **Melee** scimitar +14 ([Forceful](/Traits.aspx?ID=180), [Sweep](/Traits.aspx?ID=194)), **Damage** 1d6+7 slashing plus All Made One **Melee** fist +14 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=188)), **Damage** 1d4+7 bludgeoning plus All Made One **Ranged** composite shortbow +12 ([deadly d10](/Traits.aspx?ID=174), [Propulsive](/Traits.aspx?ID=191), [range increment 60 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248), [reload 0](/Traits.aspx?ID=254)), **Damage** 1d6+5 piercing plus All Made One **Arcane Innate Spells** DC 21 - **Cantrips (2nd)** [Detect Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=66), [Know the Way](/Spells.aspx?ID=1582) - **2nd** [Invisibility](/Spells.aspx?ID=164) (×2) - **4th** [Read Omens](/Spells.aspx?ID=247) - **7th** [Interplanar Teleport](/Spells.aspx?ID=1576) (to [Astral Plane](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2832); Elemental Planes; or [the Universe](/Planes.aspx?ID=26) only) - **Constant (5th)** [Truespeech](/Spells.aspx?ID=1728) **All Made One** The jann calls upon all of the elements that make up their being to gain an additional arcane spell they can cast at will and empower their Strikes with the element, dealing an extra 1d4 damage of the listed type. These benefits last until the jann uses this ability again. **Air** [_tailwind_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1711), 1d4 electricity; **Earth** [_pummeling rubble_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1642), 1d4 bludgeoning; **Fire** [_breathe fire_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1457), 1d4 fire; **Metal** [_thunderstrike_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1721), 1d4 electricity; **Water** [_hydraulic push_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1561), 1d4 bludgeoning; **Wood** [_summon plant or fungus_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1705), 1d4 piercing. **[Change Shape](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=55)** ([Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=127)) The jann transforms into any Small or Medium [animal](/Traits.aspx?ID=531). This doesn't affect their statistics, but it could change the damage type of their Strikes. **Wanderer's Wish** **Frequency** three times per year; **Effect** The jann instantly grants the benefits of a critical success with the [_wish_](/Rituals.aspx?ID=125) ritual to a mortal creature. This has no cost. That creature specifies what they wish for, but the interpretation is up to the jann. A jann typically attempts to grant wishes in a way that encourages growth and exploration. A summoned jann can't use this ability.
Jann Shuyookhs Jann shuyookhs add the following innate spells: **4th** [_invisibility_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1577) (×2), [_read omens_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1647).
